name: monky-screen-share-native-sources

depot_tools.reference: Frozen source acquisition tools; automatic updates are disabled

license.verification: inspect the actual pinned checkout; transitive tools have separate licenses
inspect pinned LICENSE and all applicable third_party notices before distribution

libmediasoupclient.reference: Source of the patched libmediasoupclient compiled in the native media DLL

license.verification: preserve the pinned upstream license with modified sources and binaries

bootstrap.note: Explicit fetch performs pinned Git acquisition and gclient sync --no-history --nohooks --noprehooks. DEPS Git/CIPD/GCS downloads are possible; hooks, GN, CMake and builds are not run.
bootstrap.pythonEnvironment: helpers use isolated host Python; gclient requires an explicitly provisioned private CPython 3.11 x64 venv, never global site-packages

gclientRuntime.scope: selected external imports for gclient config/sync; not the full presubmit/test-tool wheel set

bootstrap.dependencyEntriesFormat: Git: path -> URL; CIPD: path:package -> service/package@version; GCS: path:object -> gs://bucket/object

baseline.sdkVersionEvidence: rc.exe must match the SDK directory family and minimum servicing; shared Debuggers\x64 DLLs need only meet the minimum version, including newer families

limitations: This command acquires and inspects source dependencies only. It does not compile binaries or qualify capture hardware.
The separate buildRtc.cjs compiles the media core and adapters together with Chromium clang-cl/libc++, behind a versioned C/POD ABI to the MSVC Node-API addon.
Keep the pinned SDK overlays, compiler, CRT and generated headers coherent when updating WebRTC.
Git pins do not by themselves audit every DEPS/CIPD package, third-party license, host interpreter or final binary. Actual Git dependency revisions are recorded after a successful fresh sync.

Offline non-Git checks reconcile declared identities and populated install directories, CIPD control-directory presence and GCS registry membership. They do not audit individual package contents or resolve CIPD tags to immutable instance IDs.
Preserve WebRTC, libmediasoupclient, libsdptransform, JSON and all transitive licenses and corresponding sources when distributing binaries. H264 patents require separate consideration.
No verified time or disk-space estimate is available for this Windows build. Command deadlines are safety limits, not duration estimates.
